value.rules_markdown:
- Use rustfmt output and Rust 2024 idioms; snake_case for modules/files, PascalCase for types.
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file opens with a `//!` module doc describing its role and feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use `///` for help text.
- Tests live in-crate in `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` blocks, moving to sibling test files when they grow; no `tests/` directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock (`MockForge`) for testing.
- Lane behaviour is covered by golden tests with fixture diff and canned model response.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
